name: frog
about: The one design source for the Mac app (apps/FrogKit/UI/Basics/Tokens.swift) and the web app (apps/web/src/tokens.css). Edit this file, then run `node design/generate.mjs`. Spec: docs/design/frog-web/README.md, 'One look (Mac and web)'. A color with `css` becomes that CSS variable; one with `swift` becomes that `Tokens` member. Most tokens are both.

color.doc: The page: the transcript and main area. True black in the dark, true white in the light.
The web's page ground, the same as canvas.
The sidebar and inspector: opaque, one step off the canvas.
Cards, bubbles, the composer field, menus.
The prompt bubble: the same fill as cards.
Wells inside a card: code, fields, the command in an ask card.
One quiet fill for a row under the pointer and the row you're on.
Dividers: clear (no lines); kept so call sites still compile while they move to fills.
Field strokes: a faint wash, for the few controls that still need an edge.
Rails that nest content (quotes, tool output, the sidebar's started-by tree). Not a border.
The rare control edge.
The hairline on each column's inner edge (the sidebar's right, the inspector's left): quieter than line.
Primary text on the web. Solid colour for consistent contrast.
Secondary text on the web (4.5:1 on the page). Solid colour for consistent contrast.
Placeholders, quiet mono arguments on the web. Solid colour for consistent contrast.
Primary text on the Mac (solid, same as fg).
Secondary text on the Mac (solid, same as muted).
Tertiary text on the Mac (solid, same as faint).
Hints, the faintest meta (solid, same as faint).
THE accent: running, selected, verified, send. The only decorative color.
Glyphs on a frog-green fill.
The focus glow and spinner track.
Needs-you on the Mac (amber). Deprecated; use notice instead.
Failed on the Mac. Deprecated; use warn instead.
Failed, removed, over a limit (reddish-orange). The Mac's failure rows move here from fail.
Needs-you and nearing a limit on the web (orange).
A needs-you banner's fill.

Where a model runs: local (this Mac or a paired node). Blue, the same lightness as the green beside it; 4.3:1 on white, 8.3:1 on black (the green is 3.4:1 and 10:1). Only through placeColor / Color.place(_:).
Where a model runs: any cloud (Frog Cloud, Anthropic, OpenAI). Frog green, the accent. Only through placeColor / Color.place(_:).
A PR's dot (pr.*): checks failing. Worst first: failing > checks > draft > approved > closed > merged. Only through prColor / Color.pr(_:).
A PR's dot: checks running.
A PR's dot: a draft.
A PR's dot: approved and mergeable.
A PR's dot: closed without merging.
A PR's dot: merged.
A green badge's fill.
Floating menus and the palette: the sidebar fill, slightly see-through.
Glass where blur isn't available. The sidebar and inspector use --sidebar instead.
The inset highlight on glass.
The frog mark.
The frog mark.
The frog mark.
The frog mark.
The app icon's ground.
The app icon's ground, deep.

font.value: "IBM Plex Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, monospace

transcript.about: The transcript's type roles, gaps and layout, shared by the Mac and the web (docs/design/transcript/spec.md, phase 1). CSS: --tx-<role>-size/-line/-mono/-weight, --gap-<name> (comfortable; [data-density="compact"] swaps in the compact values), --tx-<layout>. Swift: Tokens.Transcript. The gaps are TurnSpace.Scale's values (footer = block + Scale.footer).

type.doc: Prose, the prompt, a card's title.
Live rows, tool lines, thoughts, the opened outline.

gap.name: footer
gap.doc: The last row and the footer: block + 4 / + 2 (TurnSpace.Scale.footer is the extra).

gap.name: block
gap.doc: The prompt and the first row; prose and a card or code box.

gap.name: activity
gap.doc: Prose and a run of lines, either way round.

gap.name: row
gap.doc: One line's height: its text line plus 4 / 2. Lines in a run touch.

gap.name: stats
gap.doc: A live row and its stats line.

gap.name: heading
gap.doc: Below a heading: it belongs to what follows (TurnSpace.Scale.heading).

layout.name: column
layout.doc: The column (TurnSpace.measure): boxes, code, tables, cards, the composer.

layout.name: prose
layout.doc: Prose stops here: paragraphs, lists, headings.

layout.name: gutter
layout.doc: Room either side of the column (TurnSpace.gutter).

layout.name: gutter-narrow
layout.doc: The gutter in a pane under 480 wide (the phone, a narrow split): under hang, so marks come inside.

layout.name: hang
layout.doc: The mark column: a line's mark sits on the column's left line and its words start this far in (18 for the mark, 8 gap).

layout.name: mark
layout.doc: A line's mark box (icon, live dot, fold chevron).

layout.name: marker
layout.doc: A list's marker column: a list's marker starts on the line and its words this far in; a nested list steps in by this per level.

layout.name: plate
layout.doc: A line's hover plate: its height.

layout.name: plate-bleed
layout.doc: How far the plate reaches past the text on each side, so words don't move.

layout.name: bubble-y
layout.doc: The prompt bubble's padding, top and bottom: one line is 38 tall.

layout.name: bubble-x
layout.doc: The prompt bubble's padding, left and right.
